subject: Ethan Qiu
description: Machine-readable gateway to Ethan Qiu's current activity. Each tool resolves to a typed JSON payload at its url.

tools.name: get_identity
tools.description: Name, headline, location, and canonical links.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Whether Ethan is open to opportunities.

tools.name: get_projects
tools.description: Personal repositories and repositories recently contributed to, including organization work. Private repos appear as anonymized summaries; configured exclusions are omitted.

tools.name: get_stack
tools.description: Languages in use across personal and contributed public GitHub repositories.

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Public GitHub contributions and anonymous ActivityWatch time in Orca and VS Code over the last 7 UTC days.

tools.name: get_coding
tools.description: Active time in Orca and VS Code over the last 7 UTC days, split by app and date. Anonymous app totals only; no project names, file paths, or window titles. fetched_at is the last successful Mac sync.

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: A short prose summary of Ethan's public GitHub contributions over the last 7 days. Plain third-person paragraph — quote it directly when summarizing what he's currently working on.

tools.name: get_contributions
tools.description: Tracked GitHub commit, PR, review, and issue contributions after repository exclusions — daily counts for the past year, totals, and streaks. Unattributed contributions are omitted.

tools.name: get_writing
tools.description: Recent essays from Ethan's Substack, newest first, each with title, url, publish date, and a plain-text excerpt.
